fact: The National Payment Systems Act, 2015 (Act No. 4 of 2015, assented 25 April 2015, gazetted 22 May 2015) regulates payment systems, payment instruments and electronic money under Bank of Tanzania licensing, applies to Mainland Tanzania and Zanzibar, and is recorded as codified in Chapter 437, Revised Edition 2023; the commencement date is by ministerial notice and is not given in the document, so the gazette date is used.

The Deputy Finance Minister told Parliament on 29 October 2026 that the Electronic Money Regulations of 2015 empower the Bank of Tanzania to set and review transaction limits by customer category and risk.
